title: agents --update-instructions --force says nothing about a surviving old .claude skill for a codex target (ODOC-556 R1 follow-up)
description: Found in the Opus review of PR #699 (N2). After QCLI-545, quest agents --update-instructions --force for a codex target exits 0 and leaves .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md untouched without mentioning it; R1 ("reports the file as drift and names the path") is met only through agents --check. Decide, with opum-doc if it is a design choice, whether update should also name the surviving file (a notice on stderr or a field), and implement it. Not part of #699.

acceptanceCriteria.text: agents --update-instructions --target codex, run in a workspace holding the old .claude skill, tells the caller the file exists and was left in place, naming its path, without changing the exit code or removing it
